rule.title: The owner's own salary and draws are not wages or cost of labor

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item the owner's own salary, or a draw or personal withdrawal the owner took from the business?

citation.wording: You can’t deduct your own salary or any personal withdrawals you make from your business. As a sole proprietor, you are not an employee of the business.
